status: Research protocol, not adopted product policy; frozen before new held-out source/native outcome inspection
unit: One native ability or supported causal branch relative to one specified objective; ordinary card entry is a separately stated conceptual route, not an invented extracted ability
criteria: Record source identity, original source text, native availability and representation before relating extraction to expected admission. Missing definition, excluded eligibility, no emitted relationship, UNKNOWN and NO_MATCH remain distinct.

Input supply needs an identifiable operation or permission changing availability, quantity, access, replenishment or usability of an objective-required resource, beyond the source merely having a qualifying type or characteristic.
Do not apply the input-only criterion to direct event production or state establishment. Test a separate stronger universal ordinary-participation exclusion for counterexamples.

State checkpoints: immediately after a permanent successfully enters under our control, or while a specified continuous modifier applies; power modification compares the same creature before/after an applicable effect. Printed power is not itself a positive change to an existing creature.

Death event means our nontoken creature actually moves battlefield to graveyard. Replacement, indestructibility, resources, legal targets and resolution remain prerequisites. A morbid history check is not a death trigger.
Land-entry event means a land enters under our control. Permission to play another land changes opportunity, not the land count already entered; mana production is a different operation.
Mark plausible interactive use from operation, recipients, controllers, choices and dependencies; do not classify every removal/damage/counter operation as interaction-only.
Test both a strict independent-contribution reading and a relationship-sensitive reading allowing one operation to serve interaction and the objective. Do not require separate printed abilities.
Costs and outputs in one action remain distinct causal contributions. A sacrifice cost can produce a qualifying death independently of the removal outcome, conditional on actual graveyard arrival.

Separate source-grounded expected contribution/admission, native expressibility, current extraction, actual query result and policy judgment. Conceptual objectives have no production query; manual judgments are not executable rules.

Counterfactual catalog diagnostic may withdraw the existing DEATH_ENHANCED_REMOVAL branch from primary results while retaining all original evidence. This is a precisely evaluated branch-withdrawal scenario, not an interaction classifier or a full evaluation of the general hypotheses.

Evaluate preservation, false-admission/exclusion risks, uncertainty, reuse, specialized meaning, feasibility and player explanation qualitatively. Do not estimate precision or recall from this purposive cohort.

candidateFormulations.A: Existing specialized policies and current four-objective acceptance.
candidateFormulations.B: Reject type-only suppliers and interaction-only contributions unless another qualifying contribution can be distinguished within the same or another branch. Stress-test a rigid interpretation requiring separation from the interactive operation; separately test universal ordinary-participation exclusion.
candidateFormulations.C: Require an explicit objective-relative relationship; allow the same operation to interact and directly produce/establish the anchor. Interaction-only remains unresolved where mechanics do not establish intended use.
candidateFormulations.D: Apply ordinary-eligibility exclusion only to supplier claims; retain objective-specific producer/state/beneficiary criteria and existing death policies pending a separate decision.

heldOutSelection.challenge: Extra land play permission versus ordinary land participation
One ability produces own death and supplies a land-entry resource
Sacrificed land versus lands put onto battlefield; resource and event types differ
Land-entry beneficiary producing mana is not the land itself supplying mana
Printed high power establishes a state without modifying another creature
Ordinary artifact/creature participation versus direct artifact-count establishment
Artifact-producing ability and ordinary artifact presence are separate contributions
Continuous power modification and return-to-hand are different relationships
Replacement enhancement is not an initiating triggered placement
Sacrifice cost with creature/player damage; interaction does not erase production
Self-death damage can target creatures or players
Death beneficiary can grant usability without conventional draw/token payoff

selectionLimitations: Known-card purposive challenges, not blinded, random, independent or representative. Familiar cases reuse retained research; held-out means not newly source/native-inspected for this study before the protocol commit. Native availability is not assumed. Missing definitions will not be silently replaced.
